title: MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
title_zh: MOSAIC：基于图像引导原型条件约束的多尺度对象中心槽适应方法——用于遥感图像超分辨率

paragraphs.en: MOSAIC是一种新的学习框架，用于遥感图像超分辨率，通过对象为中心的方法改进了结构条件的学习。 Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging. Existing methods mainly rely on dense low-resolution features as conditions, which often entangle salient objects with dominant backgrounds and provide limited abstraction for recurring structures across scales and samples. We propose MOSAIC, an object-centric representation learning framework that learns compact structural conditions for generative model adaptation. MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.
paragraphs.zh: MOSAIC是一种新的学习框架，用于遥感图像超分辨率，通过以对象为中心的方法改进了结构条件的学习。预训练的扩散Transformer为图像恢复提供了强大的生成先验，但将其应用于对结构敏感的任务仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法主要依赖密集的低分辨率特征作为条件，这常常将显著对象与主导背景纠缠在一起，并且无法为跨尺度和样本的重复结构提供足够的抽象表示。 我们提出了MOSAIC，一个以对象为中心的代表性学习框架，能够学习紧凑的结构条件以适应生成模型。 MOSAIC将退化观测数据组织成结构槽位，这些槽位捕捉了互补的对象级和布局级证据，并在不同分辨率下整合它们，同时从共享的原型记忆中检索重复出现的先验，以补充不完整的图像特定信息。 最终得到的表示通过轻量级的残差调制注入到冻结的扩散Transformer的选定层中，从而保留其预训练的生成先验。 我们将MOSAIC应用于遥感图像超分辨率任务，该任务中小对象、重复结构和大规模变化构成了一个具有挑战性的测试场景。 在UCMerced、AID和RSSCN7数据集上的实验表明，在$\times 2$和$\times 4$设置下PSNR值均有持续提升，并且在$\times 4$时LPIPS结果也表现良好。 定性结果进一步证明了该方法在保留小对象、结构边界和重复空间模式方面的改进。
